name: Modernized Theos/iOS tweak toolchain for WSL

mentions.name: Modernized Theos/iOS tweak toolchain for WSL
mentions.description: This project modernizes the legacy Theos/iOS toolchain used to build jailbreak tweaks, fixing its archaic and broken state so it is (mostly) usable on WSL for creating tweaks targeting older devices like the iPhone 4s.
mentions.problem: The old Theos/iOS toolchain is archaic and broken, making it hard to build legacy iOS jailbreak tweaks.
mentions.source_excerpt: I tried using the old Theos/iOS toolchain to make my own tweak but it was archaic and broken. So I spent my weekend fixing it up, modernizing the toolchain into being (mostly) usable on WSL.

evidence.value: I tried using the old Theos/iOS toolchain to make my own tweak but it was archaic and broken. So I spent my weekend fixing it up, modernizing the toolchain into being (mostly) usable on WSL.
